title: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Aloe Vera Grape 10ml E-Liquid
description: Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ Aloe Vera Grape blends the subtle herbal notes of Aloe Vera with the rich, juicy sweetness of ripe Grapes. The result is a smooth and refreshing vape with a delicate floral undertone that complements the natural fruitiness. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this nicotine salt e-liquid delivers a consistently smooth throat hit and optimised nicotine absorption. Its balanced 50/50 VG/PG ratio ensures full-bodied flavour with discreet vapour production, making it ideal for pod kits and vape starter kits. Juice N Power Bar Salts 6000+ e-liquids provide a cost-effective and sustainable alternative to single-use disposable vapes, offering familiar and satisfying flavours in a refillable format. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, each bottle features a childproof cap and an easy-fill nozzle for added convenience.
